component.name: YapCap
component.summary: COSMIC panel applet for AI coding usage tracking
Aplet dla panelu COSMIC do śledzenia zużycia AI do kodowania

description.p: YapCap is a native COSMIC panel applet that tracks your AI coding quota for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini, Minimax, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI Coding Plan, Kimi for Coding, OpenCode Go, OpenRouter, and Grok right from the panel. Add accounts once and YapCap fetches usage directly from provider APIs. No telemetry, no cloud sync, no separate service account required.

YapCap jest natywnym apletem dla panelu COSMIC który śledzi zużycie AI do kodowania przy pomocy Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini, Minimax, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI Coding Plan, Kimi for Coding, OpenCode Go, OpenRouter i Grok prosto z panelu. Dodaj konta raz i YapCap sprawdza zużycie bezpośrednio przez API usługodawcy. Bez telemetrii, bez synchronizacji z chmurą, bez wymagania osobnych kont do obsługi.

Use the popup to compare multiple accounts, see which CLI account is active, show all providers or all accounts side by side, switch panel styles, and follow your COSMIC light, dark, and accent color settings. Codex accounts show available banked resets and an explicit confirmation before redeeming one.

Użyj wyskakującego okna by porównać wiele kont, zobaczyć które konto jest aktywne w CLI, pokazać wszystkich dostawców i konta obok siebie oraz zmienić styl panelu. Konta Codex pokazują dostępne zapisane resety limitów; użycie jednego wymaga wyraźnego potwierdzenia.

description.p: Adds Google Antigravity as a provider with Google OAuth login and grouped usage windows.
Adds Kimi for Coding with API-key accounts, weekly and rate-limit usage windows, and optional one-time OpenCode key prefill.
Adds automatic provider detection at startup with live re-detection, tri-state provider enablement, and a popup empty-state that suggests detected providers.
Improves the popup with adaptive provider navigation, dedicated provider management, and streamlined login flows.
Fixes automatic refresh scheduling and in-progress state synchronization across multiple panel instances.
Improves multi-process lifecycle, refresh ownership, and support diagnostics.
Fixes the Claude OAuth token endpoint.
Adds shared runtime state for multi-process panel sync, owner-only refresh execution, refresh request coordination, selected-provider sync, and expanded diagnostics.
Adds GitHub Copilot as a fifth provider with browser device-flow login, Free and paid usage parsing, multi-account support, re-auth handling, and mixed one-bar/two-bar panel rendering.
